deedRow.description: A row of src/data/core/honor/deed-table.json — the deed table, not code, owns a deed's meaning

capPerIndividual.description: Total contribution per subject individual clamps at this value (keep-stolen-mochi-per-day)

amount.description: Credit size; defaults to the row's |value|

reach.description: victim = the group named by subject.groupId; witness = groups named in (or indexing members of) witnessedBy; area = the group whose homeAreaId equals the entry's areaId

description: One entry in the Ranger's deed ledger (gameStore.deedLedger). The ledger is append-only; morale, tallies, standings and wanted are derived from it at read time by src/lib/honor.ts and are never stored (List 28 law).

neglect.description: BOND-DECAY-SPEC §2/§6 — neglect tallies ride the same ledger; the moral register consumes them with context weights (party heavy / storage light / daycare moderate, personality-moderated)

deed.description: closed vocabulary — a row id in the deed table

witnessedBy.description: witness set per #272 — individual and/or group ids; possibly empty. Mochi are never witnesses (cries are not testimony, #136)

title: honor deed entry
